fullContentHtml:

The Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC) has announced the BTSC Pharmacist Result 2026 on 15th June 2026 at its official website. The results have been released in the form of an online scorecard. All those candidates who appeared for the BTSC Pharmacist recruitment examination 2026 on 04th June can now check and download their online results by simply visiting the official BTSC website, btsc.bihar.nic.in. To make it easier for candidates, we have also shared a direct link along with a detailed step-by-step process for the same in the article shared below. 

BTSC Pharmacist Result 2026 OUT 

The BTSC Pharmacist Recruitment Examination 2026 is a state-level recruitment exam conducted by the Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC) to select 2,473 qualified candidates for government pharmacist positions under the Health Department of the Government of Bihar. The selection process includes two primary stages: a Computer-Based Test (CBT) and a Weightage for Work Experience. For the year 2026, the BTSC Pharmacist Prelims Recruitment Examination was successfully conducted on 04th June at various examination centres. After the completion of the exam, candidates were eagerly waiting for the announcement of their results. So this is to inform them that their wait is finally over, as BTSC has released BTSC Pharmacist Merit List 2026 on 15th June at its official portal. 

BTSC Pharmacist Result 2026 PDF Download Link

The official window to check and download the online BTSC Pharmacist Result 2026 has been activated at the official Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC) website on 15th June 2026. The scorecards comprise necessary details such as the candidate’s personal information, obtained marks, pass/fail status and much more. As the online scorecards have been issued, candidates can now check and download their online BTSC Pharmacist Prelims Merit List PDF either through the official website or by simply clicking on the direct link shared here. 

BTSC Pharmacist Result 2026 OUT: Click to Check 

btsc.bihar.gov.in Pharmacist Result 2026 – Highlights 

The must-awaited BTSC Pharmacist Prelims results have been announced by the Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC) on its official portal. Candidates can also check all important details regarding the pharmacist results through the table shared below: 

BTSC Pharmacist Result 2026 – Highlights 
Name of examination  BTSC Pharmacist Recruitment Examination 2026
Conducting Body  Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC)

How to Check BTSC Pharmacist Result 2026 at btsc.bihar.nic.in?

Step 1: Go to official Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC) website i.e., btsc.bihar.nic.in

Step 2: Look for latest updates section on the left-hand side of homepage.

Step 3: Click on “BTSC Pharmacist Result 2026” PDF download link.

Step 4: Check all details mentioned on BTSC Pharmacist merit list.

Step 5: Do not forget to download and save the detailed BTSC Pharmacist Prelims Result PDF for future use. 

What Details are mentioned on BTSC Pharmacist Merit List 2026?

After downloading the BTSC Pharmacist Result 2026 PDF, candidates are advised to make sure they check all the details mentioned on it. And if any error is found make sure you get it rectified as soon as possible. Some of the details that will be updated in the online merit list has also been discussed below:

  • Candidate’s Name 
  • Roll Number
  • Registration Number
  • Date pof Birth 
  • Category  (Gen. OBC, ST, SC, etc.)
  • Gender
  • Name of Examination
  • Subject-wise Marks scored 
  • Overall Percentage 
  • BTSC Pharmacist Cut Off 
  • Pass/Fail Status 
  • BTSC Signature and stamp
  • Details regarding the next stage

What’s Next After BTSC Pharmacist Merit List 2026?

After the annpouncemnt of BTSC Pharmacist Merit List 2026, the first step is to download the online results. Shortlisted candidates will then be called for document verification (DV). During this stage, candidates must present their original educational certificates, pharmacy registration certificate, identity proof, category certificate (if applicable), and other required documents. The authorities will verify all details submitted in the application form. Candidates who successfully clear the verification process will be considered for the final selection list. After that, BTSC will issue appointment letters to selected candidates, and they will be required to complete joining formalities at their allotted department or institution. 

BTSC Pharmacist Result 2026: FAQs 

Q1. What is BTSC Pharmacist result 2026 date?

Answer: The official BTSC Pharmacist Merit Lists have been announced on 15th June 2026.

Q2. How many vacancies are there for the BTSC Pharmacist Recruitment 2026?

Answer: There are a total of 2,473 vacancies announced for the BTSC Pharmacist recruitment 2026.

Q3. Where is the result link for the BTSC Pharmacist Preliminary exam 2026 activated?

Answer: BTSC Pharmacist Merit List 2026 download link has been activated at the official website, btsc.bihar.nic.in

Q4. Who is responsible for the conduction of BTSC Pharmacist recruitment exam 2026?

Answer: The BTSC Pharmacist recruitment exam is conducted by the Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC)
